title: Air Starter Motor and Supply Duct — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the air starter motor and the supply duct from the accessory gearbox pad, with the duct joint examination that records fretting before the faces are cleaned.

sections.purpose: This task removes the air starter motor and the supply duct so that the motor can be replaced, the duct clamps changed, or the joint faces examined and re-machined.
sections.job_setup_note: The engine must be cold. The fan cowls must not be opened above the crosswind limit given in the maintenance manual, and the cowl hold-open rods must both be fitted. The duct joint faces must be examined and photographed before anything is cleaned; once a face is wiped the fretting evidence is gone.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the engine has been shut down for at least two hours and that the aircraft is not on the auxiliary power unit. 2. Check the crosswind against the limit and open the fan cowls in zone 421. Fit both hold-open rods. WARNING: DO NOT OPEN THE FAN COWLS ABOVE THE CROSSWIND LIMIT AND DO NOT LEAVE THEM OPEN WITHOUT BOTH HOLD-OPEN RODS FITTED. 3. Isolate the start system and tag the control in the flight compartment. 4. Disconnect the starter electrical connector and cap it. 5. Release the aft clamp D8010119758805 at the duct joint and support the duct. 6. Release the forward clamp PE187919-09 and lower the duct clear. CAUTION: SUPPORT THE DUCT BEFORE THE SECOND CLAMP IS RELEASED. THE DUCT WILL SWING ONTO THE ACCESSORY GEARBOX. 7. Photograph both joint faces before cleaning and record the fretting depth at four points on each face. 8. Remove the seal 5193ES and put it in a bag with the aircraft registration on it. 9. Release the starter attachment nuts at the gearbox pad in the sequence given and support the motor. 10. Withdraw the motor from the pad and lower it on the sling. 11. Blank the gearbox pad immediately. 12. Examine the nozzle WES955482-79 for erosion at the throat and record the condition. 13. Check the firewall panel 983ES and the forward duct 2788ES3 for chafe where the duct has moved.
sections.close_out: Blank the gearbox pad and both duct ends. Keep the photographs and the fretting measurements with the work pack; they feed the fleet clamp standard. Do not clean a joint face until the measurements are recorded and signed.

type_data.effectivity_note: Auran 7000 aircraft; the forward clamp of step 6 is a two-piece item post modification

safety_precautions: Do not open the fan cowls above the crosswind limit.
Isolate and tag the start control.
